autorotate.config.title: AutoRotate Settings
autorotate.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. Same as the toggle key.
autorotate.config.strictSchematic.toolti: Only place the block the schematic wants, and only where it wants one.
autorotate.config.noBlockInteraction.too: Right-clicking chests, hoppers, levers and the like never opens or triggers them while the mod is on.
autorotate.config.deferToBlockInteractio: Only used when Block GUIs is off: a plain click on an interactive block opens it as usual.
autorotate.config.controlClickedFace.too: Lets the mod click a different face to get hoppers, logs, slabs, stairs and similar blocks right.
autorotate.config.debugLog.tooltip: Writes every placement decision to the game log.
autorotate.config.autoSwitchHotbar.toolt: Switches to the hotbar slot holding the block the schematic wants.
autorotate.config.swapFromInventory.tool: Moves the block from the inventory into an empty hotbar slot, or the least used block slot when the hotbar is full.
autorotate.config.swapSettleTicks.toolti: Ticks to wait after pulling a block from the inventory before placing it.
autorotate.config.adjustDiodes.tooltip: Clicks placed repeaters and comparators until their delay or mode matches the schematic.
autorotate.config.placeCooldownMs.toolti: Minimum time between placements. 0 means no limit.
autorotate.config.onePlacePerTick.toolti: Sends at most one placement or block click per game tick, so anti-cheats like Grim do not cancel fast placements as ghost blocks. Extra clicks wait for the next tick.
autorotate.config.moveFix.tooltip: Keeps movement consistent with the rotation sent to the server, so moving while placing does not rubber-band.
autorotate.config.realAim.tooltip: Turns your actual camera instead of only the rotation sent to the server.
autorotate.config.headSettleTicks.toolti: Extra ticks before clicking observers, pistons, dispensers, droppers, barrels and crafters.
autorotate.config.maxSpoofWaitTicks.tool: How long to wait for the rotation to reach the server before giving up.
autorotate.config.maxAimStepDegrees.tool: Largest turn per tick. 0 turns instantly.
autorotate.config.maxAimTicks.tooltip: How long a turn may take before the placement is dropped.
autorotate.config.realAimSettleTicks.too: Ticks to hold the camera on target before clicking in Real Aim mode.
msg.autorotate.noSource: AutoRotate: the %s here flows, but the schematic has no source for it
msg.autorotate.alreadyFlowing: AutoRotate: the %s here flows from %s, which is already placed
autorotate.config.iceForWater.tooltip: With no water bucket, place ice at the water source and break it so it melts into water. Survival only; tools with Silk Touch are skipped.
msg.autorotate.iceCreative: AutoRotate: ice does not melt when broken in creative
msg.autorotate.iceEvaporates: AutoRotate: ice would evaporate here instead of melting
msg.autorotate.iceNoFloor: AutoRotate: ice only melts into water with a solid block or liquid under it
msg.autorotate.iceSilkTouch: AutoRotate: every hotbar tool has Silk Touch, the ice would not melt
msg.autorotate.iceFailed: AutoRotate: could not turn ice into water at %s
autorotate.config.autoWaterlog.tooltip: Fills the spot with water first when the schematic wants a waterlogged block or a water plant there.
autorotate.config.stackLayers.tooltip: Keeps clicking until snow layers, candles, sea pickles, turtle eggs, petals, leaf litter and double slabs match the schematic.
autorotate.config.respectLayerRange.tool: Only builds on the Litematica layers you are currently showing.
msg.autorotate.hiddenLayer: AutoRotate: that spot is on a hidden Litematica layer
msg.autorotate.needsSupport: AutoRotate: %s needs the block at %s placed first
msg.autorotate.breakFailed: AutoRotate: could not break the block at %s
msg.autorotate.clickSource: AutoRotate: this %s flows from %s - right-click that spot to place the source
msg.autorotate.chestPartner: AutoRotate: %s cannot pair with the chest at %s (it faces another way or is already double)
msg.autorotate.wrongType: AutoRotate: cannot place %s as %s from here
msg.autorotate.wrongHinge: AutoRotate: %s would not get a %s hinge here - the blocks beside it decide the hinge, place the door before them
